question: Which deities and mantra elements are invoked to receive the ritual offering?
premises: A receiving pair and fire-beauty are named
inference: The offering is directed to the field-protector together with the receiving pair and the deity called fire-beauty.
uncertainties: The precise identity of the receiving pair and fire-beauty within this mantra sequence is unclear.
plain_english: O field-protector, take the offering, together with the receiving pair and Pāvakasundarī.
